Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 1
, Reason for Mistake: In the very first step, the Planner incorrectly identified "Ralph Stafford, 1st Earl of Stafford" as the father of Thomas Stafford, 3rd Earl of Stafford based on a misleading search snippet. The correct father is Hugh Stafford, 2nd Earl of Stafford. The Planner failed to verify this conflicting information against the Wikipedia snippet present in the same search results (which correctly identified Hugh Stafford) before proceeding with further searches, leading to an initial erroneous conclusion that propagated confusion.
